say:1:1623432001:1.text: You've probably noticed it too. The mood on campus has been off lately.
say:1:1623432001:1.source_cn: 想必你已有所察觉，近期校园舆论的动向非常奇怪。
say:1:1623432001:1.male: You've probably noticed it too. The mood on campus has been off lately.
say:1:1623432001:1.female: You've probably noticed it too. The mood on campus has been off lately.

say:2:1623432002:1.text: The speed and pattern of these discussions don't seem natural. It feels more like something is deliberately steering them.
say:2:1623432002:1.source_cn: 从传播路径和话题发酵速度来看，这并非自然形成的讨论，更...
say:2:1623432002:1.male: The speed and pattern of these discussions don't seem natural. It feels more like something is deliberately steering them.
say:2:1623432002:1.female: The speed and pattern of these discussions don't seem natural. It feels more like something is deliberately steering them.

say:3:1623432003:1.text: I need you to keep an eye on those two reporters, Reeo and Bel.
say:3:1623432003:1.source_cn: 我需要你继续关注那两位记者——雷欧与巴布。
say:3:1623432003:1.male: I need you to keep an eye on those two reporters, Reeo and Bel.
say:3:1623432003:1.female: I need you to keep an eye on those two reporters, Reeo and Bel.

say:4:1623432004:1.text: Watch what they do, who they talk to, what stories they chase. That's probably how we find where this really starts.
say:4:1623432004:1.source_cn: 通过他们的行动，我们也许能想办法厘清这股暗流的关键线索。
say:4:1623432004:1.male: Watch what they do, who they talk to, what stories they chase. That's probably how we find where this really starts.
say:4:1623432004:1.female: Watch what they do, who they talk to, what stories they chase. That's probably how we find where this really starts.

say:5:1623432005:1.text: And be careful. Until we know the truth, don't let anyone realize we're looking into this.
say:5:1623432005:1.source_cn: 切记，谨慎行事。在查明真相前，不要打草惊蛇。
say:5:1623432005:1.male: And be careful. Until we know the truth, don't let anyone realize we're looking into this.
say:5:1623432005:1.female: And be careful. Until we know the truth, don't let anyone realize we're looking into this.
